# #247 — Design DreamEngine decomposition for oversized Open Brain entries

## Problem

Issue #192 intentionally split into:

- Part A: compact exact-UUID retrieval through `get_entry render=compact` (handled by PR #246)
- Part B: DreamEngine-driven decomposition of oversized entries into smaller linked entries

Part B should not remain only as prose after #192 closes. It needs its own tracked issue before implementation.

## Scope

Design and implement a dry-run-first DreamEngine workflow that can detect oversized Open Brain entries and propose smaller linked replacements without mutating data by default.

Required design points:

- oversized-entry detection per source family;
- proposed smaller replacement entries with links back to the original source context;
- dry-run review output that an operator/client can inspect;
- explicit operator or client approval before archive, promote, demote, tier mutation, or replacement writes;
- namespace-safe provenance for every generated replacement;
- regression tests proving DreamEngine remains dry-run-by-default unless an explicit mutating wrapper opts in.

## Non-goals

- Do not fold this into compact `get_entry` rendering.
- Do not mutate production entries from dream planning without an explicit approval path.
- Do not treat hosted deploy/downstream rollout as part of this local design issue unless a later release issue opts in.

## Relationship

Follow-up to #192 and PR #246.
